# This section has been AI-generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) on 24.10.2026
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(hisaab
    VERSION 1.0.0
    DESCRIPTION "Hisaab (हिसाब) - Spatial UI Calculator for Wayland, syncing with Noctalia"
    LANGUAGES CXX
)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Enable compiler warnings & optimization
if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W4 /permissive-)
else()
    add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -O3)
endif()

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Quick Qml)

qt_standard_project_setup()

set(SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/engine/math_parser.cpp
    src/engine/programmer_mode.cpp
    src/engine/calc_engine.cpp
    src/theme/theme_manager.cpp
)

set(HEADERS
    src/engine/calc_types.h
    src/engine/math_parser.h
    src/engine/programmer_mode.h
    src/engine/calc_engine.h
    src/theme/theme_manager.h
)

qt_add_executable(hisaab
    ${SOURCES}
    ${HEADERS}
)

target_include_directories(hisaab PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/engine
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/theme
)

target_link_libraries(hisaab PRIVATE
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Quick
    Qt6::Qml
)

# This section has been AI-generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) on 24.10.2026
qt_add_qml_module(hisaab
    URI "Hisaab"
    VERSION 1.0
    QML_FILES
        qml/Main.qml
        qml/components/SpatialCard.qml
        qml/components/CalcButton.qml
        qml/components/DisplayPanel.qml
        qml/components/ModeBar.qml
        qml/components/Keypad.qml
        qml/components/RadixPanel.qml
        qml/components/BitsetPanel.qml
        qml/components/HistoryDrawer.qml
    RESOURCES
        assets/hisaab.png
)
# End of AI-generated section.

# This section has been AI-generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) on 25.10.2026
# Installation target
include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS hisaab
    BUNDLE DESTINATION .
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)
install(FILES hisaab.desktop DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications)
install(FILES assets/hisaab.png DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps)
install(FILES assets/hisaab.png DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/pixmaps)
# End of AI-generated section.

# Testing target
enable_testing()
add_executable(test_engine
    tests/test_engine.cpp
    src/engine/math_parser.cpp
    src/engine/programmer_mode.cpp
)
target_include_directories(test_engine PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/engine)
add_test(NAME EngineTests COMMAND test_engine)
# End of AI-generated section.
